overview.description: The MicroSectors Solactive FANG & Innovation - 3X Inverse Leveraged ETN (BERZ) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Solactive FANG Innovation index. The fund tracks 300% inverse of the daily price movements of an equal-weighted index of US-listed technology companies. BERZ was launched on Aug 20, 2021 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
